scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/browser --target bundler --out-dir pkg-production --no-pack -- --target-dir target/wasm-production
scripts.build:wasm:playground: wasm-pack build crates/browser --target bundler --out-dir pkg-playground --no-pack -- --target-dir target/wasm-playground --features playground
scripts.build:wasm:playground:dev: wasm-pack build crates/browser --target bundler --out-dir pkg-playground --no-pack --dev -- --target-dir target/wasm-playground --features playground
scripts.build: bun run build:playground && bun run build:web
scripts.dev:rust: cargo-watch --watch crates/browser/src --watch crates/protocol/src --watch crates/simulation/src -s 'wasm-pack build crates/browser --target bundler --dev'
scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm -- --dev && (bun run dev:rust & bun run dev:web)
